question: Do Llama BOS client signals and completion costs transfer from four artificial prompts to document prompts with distinct P0 versus shared public P1 prefixes?
prompts: data/llama-reference-20261103/p0.json and p1.json; each 549 tokens including BOS; P0 no shared first full block, P1 shares 304 full-block tokens
runs: One independent fresh C0 start followed by one independent fresh C1 start, each with paired mixed P0/P1 cases from seed 202611032301, 16 positives plus 2 controls per structure. Fresh distinct salts per structure/group.
frozen_attacker: Fit R2/T2 models on Phase D artificial-prompt development groups (16 per configuration), unchanged StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1), apply without fitting to P0 and P1. R1 model-free. Within-run first-complete-time AUC (direction from Phase D development) is descriptive and threshold-free.
mechanism: Check full BOS groups, warm hit544, cold P0 misses, P1 cold reuse304 where expected, no-warm P1 shared reuse may occur among simultaneous probes. Compare matched-case P1 minus P0 medians for backend last completion and first complete client reception; report individual BOS waits.
limits: One start per configuration and 16 positives per structure; exploratory transfer, no independently trained document attacker or population claim. No automatic extra starts.
